question: Does Huawei Cloud SWR Basic Edition impose an image quota? The General FAQ (updated 2025-03-25) says 'No quotas are imposed on SWR images', and the Basic Edition push and console-upload pages (updated 2026-09-28) say a tenant can push up to 500 images and 300 tags for each image.
why: free_tier.stated, unit 'unlimited', verdict 'qualifies' and the limits list rest on the FAQ; the newer user-guide pages contradict them, so the free tier is bounded by image and tag counts.
